Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
•	Approximately 10–12 years of experience implementing and architecting ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
•	Extensive experience across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, CMDB, App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, and platform customization.
•	Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs and IntegrationHub.
•	Hands-on experience leading ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, domain-separated implementations, and enterprise migrations.
•	Experience implementing Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise testing strategies.
•	Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and leading discovery workshops, solution design, and technical governance.
•	Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem is highly desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies:
•	Expert knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
•	Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Service Portal/Workspaces.
•	Deep understanding of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, CMDB, Discovery, and ServiceNow security architecture.
•	Experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
•	Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, integration patterns, and automation frameworks.
•	Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to engage CXO-level audiences.
•	Strong leadership, mentoring, architectural governance, and decision-making capabilities.
•	Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions while driving AI-first digital transformation initiatives.

Our client is one of the biggest manufacturers of spices and sauces, having been in the industry for 130 years, they've established themselves as a reputable food manufacturing brand. They currently have an opportunity for high reach forklift operators to join their team. This role will have you complete a mixture of forklift and hands on tasks. So, if you don't mind jumping off the forklift and adding a bit of variety to your duties, we encourage you to apply! 
 They are currently looking to fill the  day, afternoon and   night  shift   vacancy. Please select your shift preference in the questionaire when you apply for the role. 
   
  Key Responsibilities:  
 
 Working in the dispatch and receiving department 
 Operating a high reach forklift (Crown Joystick) to rack and un-rack pallets 
 Picking and preparing outbound orders for dispatch 
 Using an RF scanner while picking 
 Stacking cartons (weighs 15 - 25kg) onto pallets. Vacuum lifter is utilize for heavier loads 
 
   
  About you:  
 
 Hold a valid forklift license 
 Confident in your high reach operating, and ability to navigate through tight aisles 
 Experience with RF scanning or pick packing 
 Comfortable with the manual handling aspects of the role 
 Looking for long term consistent work 
 
   
  What's in it for you:  
 
 Opportunity to upskill and grow 
 On site parking 
 Lunchroom stocked with tea and coffee 
 
   
 While the requirements listed above are what's preferred, we are looking for people who are looking for a long term role and willingness to learn. If you don't necessary tick all the boxes but posses the drive and transferable skills, we encourage you to apply! 
  You must provide Proof of Work documents to work in Australia (Australian Birth Certificate or current Passport) to be considered for this role. Please note all applications will be treated as private and confidential and only shortlisted candidates will be notified.  
   
  Who we are  
 As one of Australia's largest employers, we work with great companies all around Australia and New Zealand to give you the best opportunities to work when and where you want to. 
 At Programmed, we are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment which values and respects diverse styles, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. 
 We welcome and encourage women, people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent and people from diverse backgrounds to apply. 
   So it's over to you. If you would like to join our team, APPLY now.   
  To learn more about working with Programmed, we encourage you to visit our website.   Please  click here  to apply.

Our team is dedicated to providing efficient business solutions while fostering a positive workplace culture and ensuring compliance with Australian workplace standards.

Role Summary
The Human Resource Adviser provides professional advice on human resource policies, workplace relations, and employment conditions. The role supports recruitment, performance management, and employee relations while ensuring compliance with Australian employment legislation.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
•	Develop, implement, and review human resource policies and procedures to ensure compliance with current workplace legislation and organisational requirements.

•	Advise management on remuneration structures, employee benefits, and workforce planning strategies aligned with business objectives.
•	Manage employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary procedures, and conflict resolution in accordance with company policy and legal requirements.
•	Maintain HR records and analyse workforce data to prepare reports that support strategic decision-making.
•	Assist with organisational change initiatives by providing guidance on change management, communication strategies, and employee engagement programs.

Qualifications and Experience
•	Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in a related field, or equivalent.
•	Minimum one year experience in a Human Resource Adviser or HR Generalist role.
•	Sound knowledge of Australian employment legislation and HR best practices.
•	Strong communication, analytical, and organisational skills.

How to Apply
Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV along with a brief cover letter outlining their suitability for the Human Resource Adviser position at QLD TC SERVICES PTY LTD.

Residential Care -    Recreation and Engagement Assistant  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Recreation and Engagement Assistant role based in Narrandera  
  Casual Role  
  Salary packaging opportunities up to $31,800 per year  
 
  About Us:  At RSL LifeCare, our Residential Care teams have the ability to make a big difference to the lives of veterans and seniors while they receive quality and compassionate care in our aged care homes. This is an opportunity for you to join a large social purpose organisation where you can have a huge positive impact and feel the personal and professional reward in return. At our core, RSL LifeCare provide care and services to veterans and seniors who live in our communities or who are receiving support at home. Our vision of creating proud communities living their best lives is at the heart of everything we do as we continue to build upon our legacy of supporting veterans and their families for more than 100 years.   About the role:  As a Recreation and Engagement Assistant at RSL LifeCare, every day you're empowered to make a meaningful difference to people's lives. Within our supportive work environment your skills and compassion are valued. You will have the opportunity to: 
 
 Support the goals of care for the residents in the service in partnership with each resident and/or their representative 
 Identify barriers that prevent consumers from participating in meaningful and enjoyable activities 
 Encourage the wellbeing and independence of residents by supporting them to engage in preferred activities and interests 
 Embody a person-centred approach, recognising and promoting the individual's unique goals and preferences 
 Participate in risk management and continuous quality improvement activities 
 Build strong and productive relationships with your team to deliver positive outcomes for residents 
 
  About you  
 
 A fantastic outlook on life with a fun personality! 
 Experience working in Lifestyle/Recreational Activities teams in Aged care/Disability/Community services  desirable  
 Cert IV in Leisure and Health and/ or relevant tertiary degree  preferable  
 A sound understanding of aged care and the principles guiding this sector 
 General computer skills 
 Australian work rights 
 
  ?It is a mandatory requirement for a team member working in the Aged Care sector to have a valid RSL LifeCare Police Check or a valid National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) check, or potentially both, to undertake the inherent requirements of the role.    Our commitment to diversity  We welcome and encourage applications from people across our diverse community, especially from Veterans, current serving ADF personnel, their families and Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants. We believe everyone has the right to feel safe, respected, valued and heard regardless of their gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity or disability.

Role:

BatFast is a leader in global sports technology. Founded in 2016 to increase participation in sports worldwide. We use data, augmented reality technology, machine learning, and robotics to re-engineer how sports are played. We use technology to change the game. With data and patented technology, we’ve made sports more accessible for beginners and aspiring professionals alike - whether you're here to play, complete, or improve.

We currently innovate, design, develop, and build multisport simulators for training and entertainment industries. We have a great pipeline of products and features we are working on over the next few years. There will be many aspects of the business to get involved in within our highly dynamic, passionate, and ever-growing team.

The BatFast team is looking for a multi-skilled candidate with excellent interpersonal skills for the position of Services & Operations manager, who will help coordinate, develop and innovate the operational function within the business.

Responsibilities

? Innovation

- Advocate for sharing best practices and insights with other teams.

- Independently execute projects & initiatives, involving and delegating tasks to the team for collective success.

- Utilise cross-functional feedback to establish innovative and standardised approaches to work.

- Motivate the BatFast team members to share and fully implement new ideas

? Product Delivery

- Project manage installations in coordination with the Supply Chain Manager.

- Develop maintenance and service systems in line with site/machine requirements, working closely with the technical department.

- Train staff internally and externally on installation, production, assembly &

maintenance service as required.

- Development of risk assessments and health & safety systems.

- Foster a spirit of continuous improvement within the Operations team.

- Proactively identify and resolve obstacles for the team and ensure all SLAs are met.

- Implement standard practices with the team to ensure procedures are followed consistently

- Maintain high standards when ensuring all systems are utilised correctly by BatFast team members

- Play a crucial role in the successful execution of various large-scale and strategic programs and projects, engaging all stakeholders.

- Ensure clear project plans are agreed upon by the team.

? Client Success

- Drive client onboarding processes.

- Manage hands-on activities of the team, including assembly, deliveries, installations & packaging.

- Manage B2B customer relationships and ensure customer success.

- Support installations as required - finding suppliers, reducing installation time, and shipping costs.

- Effectively address challenges raised by stakeholders, to ensure a seamless client experience.

- Manage client expectations using product knowledge & experience.

- Establish targets for client service excellence, including NPS scores, and communicate them clearly to the entire team.

- Confidently handle client challenges and resolve issues to promote client success.

? Team

- Build, recruit, train and manage agency staff and interns supporting installations, production & maintenance.

- Collaborate with the Technical department and Supply Chain Manager to improve the production/assembly process.

- Provide operational leadership support for investment and raise conversations.

- Assist BatFast team members to develop individual skills.

- Provide mentorship and support to junior team members.

About You:

? Experience

- Relevant qualification such as Business, or equivalent professional experience.

- 5 years working in industry, (project management/client relationships)

- International experience - Collaborating with diverse stakeholders, managing global projects and navigating cross-cultural environments effectively.

- Tooling experience - the role involves working with specialised equipment and tools integral to the production and assembly processes.

- Understanding of the Sport industry - All 3 sports (Cricket, Baseball, & Tennis)

? Innovative thinking

- Ability to find creative solutions to challenges and adapt to changing market demands, by implementing new ideas.Adaptability

? Adaptability

- With shifting market trends, evolving customer preferences, and technological advancements, you must be adaptable to embrace change, and pivot strategies when necessary.

? Communication

- Effective communication is essential to convey expectations, align team members, and collaborate with various stakeholders.

? Team Management and Collaboration

- Effective team management involves motivating and empowering team members to achieve shared objectives.

- Openness to help the business in other departments in busy periods not directly linked to Services and Operations.

Extended Responsibilities

? Operational Strategy Delivery

- Take responsibility for supporting the implementation of BatFast’s operational strategy, ensuring that day to day operations and international projects are aligned and within budget.

- Create and implement a sustainable support and service structure for the Australian market ensuring budget constraints are met.

- Own and manage BatFast Australia stock to meet cost efficiency measures.

- Create Australia's supply chain for cost effective and scalable deployment

? Resource and Supply Planning Responsibility

- Responsible for building the Operations team in Australia in a cost-effective manner, such that the business is profitable and can scale.

- Be accountable for providing accurate data, forecasts and recommendations to inform operational resources and supply planning in line with the sales pipeline. Ensure resource plans are delivered effectively within assigned projects.

- Report and monitor client performance metrics, usage patterns, SLA’s and satisfaction levels to ensure optimal outcomes and proactively address any issues before they impact the relationship.

? Client Success Ownership

- Supporting commercially for region wide business developments as and when requested to ensure the success of BatFast in Australia

- Take responsibility for identifying and resolving operational barriers that may affect

client delivery within international projects, ensuring issues are escalated appropriately and client expectations are met.

? Budget Responsibility

- Monitor and track costs within assigned projects, ensuring efficiencies are achieved and escalating budgetary concerns where required, escalating financial decisions to the Head of operations

- Clear focus on reducing costs to supply, install, train, service and maintain for the Australian business to be successful in scaling

? Team Mentorship & Coaching

- Provide day to day coaching, guidance and support for operational team members and agency staff on-site, enabling effective delivery of installations, services and maintenance.

- Full performance management accountability for all staff locally

? Account Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for all BatFast Australian clients, building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships that drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.

- Proactively identify and close opportunities to grow revenues with existing clients

- Take accountability for revenue growth from existing Australian accounts, and achieve annual revenue growth & NPS targets

- Oversee contract renewals, negotiations, and variations, ensuring terms are mutually beneficial and support long-term partnerships
